page: Amazon Web Services i7ie.18xlarge is a storage-optimized server built on the AWS Nitro System. It features an Intel Xeon 8559C processor with 72 vCPUs and 36 physical cores running at a base frequency of 3.2 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. The hardware configuration includes 576.0 GB of DDR5 memory operating at 6 GHz, providing a balanced 8.0 GB of RAM per core. A primary differentiator of this instance is its massive local storage capacity, consisting of 45,000 GB of NVMe SSD storage. Network performance is supported by a 38 Gbps baseline bandwidth.

Benchmark results indicate strong multi-core and memory performance. The server achieved a Geekbench multi-core score of 20,730.0 and a single-core score of 2,297.0, placing its processing capabilities in the top tier. Memory bandwidth is highly efficient, reaching 287.15 GB/sec for large block read-only operations and 120.7 GB/sec for write operations. Database operations are robust, with a Passmark database score of 32,734.62 and Redis SET operations reaching 91.92 million operations per second. Static web serving throughput is also exceptional, measured at 109.44 GB/sec.

Given the massive 45 TB local NVMe SSD storage and 576 GB of DDR5 RAM, the i7ie.18xlarge offers high resource density for storage-intensive and memory-heavy workloads. While it lacks GPU acceleration, making it less suitable for heavy deep learning training, its CPU features Advanced Matrix Extensions (AMX) and AVX-512, which support efficient CPU-based AI inference, as demonstrated by a prompt processing speed of 244.66 tokens/second on a 7B LLM. This server is highly optimized for large-scale databases, data warehousing, high-performance web serving, and intensive ETL processes requiring rapid local storage access.
